summary: Extended the strongest finding's scope with a five-voter run of the same trimmed case, so the starved follower is one of five voters and the leader keeps a majority of healthy followers while retrying. The scenario driver now takes the voter count as a parameter and the new case is selected alone, with the three established predicates (repeated snapshot installs on an unchanged snapshot index, the follower not reaching the cluster frontier, and the stale cached claim persisting) plus the same premise admission; scenario, stores, TrailingLogs, write pattern, window, anchors and assertions are otherwise identical to the decided three-voter case, so a difference would be attributable to cluster size. A local construction run reproduced the same signature (claim at index 102 in term 2 over an installed snapshot at 83 in term 3, restores 4 -> 1448 in three seconds, applied fixed at 83 while the frontier reached 95, store suffix 84-102 kept, one stable leader set), but that is construction feedback only; the retained receipt is requested with this update. No interpretation changes were made this turn, since the parent account stands as recorded and its larger-cluster limitation will be updated only once the receipt exists.
